notes: Hand-verified findings used as an evaluation set. Pages are 1-based physical PDF pages. Quotes are exact substrings of the page text after collapsing whitespace (" ".join(text.split())). Issues with expected_grade NONE are negative controls and must NOT be flagged. Issues with status under_review or candidate_new_finding are reported but not scored. Status explained: a negative control confirmed by hand (scored). Issues with a finding_id (species_range, accreditation, tor_promise) are scored against that finding in the app export (results/great_nicobar_2021_draft.json), not by the contradiction check. verification_outcome is confirmed, confirmed_with_nuance or explained; verified_wording and verified_title are the wording shown on the app card. direct_control: the negative control's own quotes are also sent to Ultra as a pair (the 10-page evaluation).

issues.summary: The report is inconsistent about coral at the port site.

quotes.text: As per the ZSI report, no coral exists in the bay portion of the Galathea Bay.
Are any coral reefs in the area? Yes Coral reef exists in the proposed site for Transshipment / Port

issues.verification_note: p.978 (Form 1 screening): "Coral reef exists in the proposed site for Transshipment / Port"; p.392 and p.738: corals outside the construction area; p.392 plans translocation "if affected".
issues.verified_wording: The report is inconsistent about coral at the port site: the Form 1 screening (p.978) says coral reef exists in the proposed port site, while pp.392 and 738 place the corals outside the construction area and plan translocation only "if affected" (p.392).
issues.verified_title: Inconsistent about coral at the port site

issues.summary: Coral loss of 1-2 ha (port) vs about 4 ha of restoration (whole project) is explained on p.751. Must NOT be flagged (second negative control).

quotes.text: However, even if there is any loss of corals during construction, it would not exceed 1-2 ha at the maximum.
Approximately 4ha of Coral restoration has been considered.
involves restoration for the entire project including Port, Power plant and Township

issues.verification_note: p.751 Table 10.3 says the ~4 ha restoration "involves restoration for the entire project including Port, Power plant and Township", so 1-2 ha (port) vs 4 ha (whole project) is not a contradiction. TigerFish correctly grades it NONE; scored as a second negative control.
